contexts.text: But with Spirits it is discussed in a minute... by perceiving the agreements and disagreements (of these things).
He reduced all things in the external man into an accordant state.
In the other life they for the most part meet. (See Marriage.)
All who are in the same good, meet and are together in the other life; and also all who are in the same truth. Signified.
As all the good which inflows with light from the Lord is terminated in what is obscure of man, the north is called the assembly ().
See Meet, To.
(Relatives) for the most part meet there...
They who have hated each other... meet there...
The thought can no longer... choose the things which agree...
The third (introduction into gyres) is that they mutually agree together as to thoughts and as to affections. The fourth is that they agree in truths and goods.

Hence it is that in the other life those meet who in the world had been in any conjunction either through love, friendship, or veneration, when they long for it; but they are afterwards disjoined according to the dissimilitudes of the state of the life.
I will meet thee there () = hearing and reception. To meet, when said by Jehovah, = hearing and reception.
Where I will meet you to speak to thee () = His presence and influx... For to meet = presence. AC 10148. AC 10197. AC 10305.

He called it the Tent of the assembly () = the external of worship, of the Church, and of the Word, in which are internal things... By the assembly is signified where internal things are; for all internal things are together in external ones. By the assembly, in the sense of the letter, is meant the assembly of the sons of Israel; but in the internal sense is signified the assembly of the truths and goods of the Church... And all celestial and spiritual things inflow into natural and worldly ones, and cease in them, and form and constitute them. Hence it is that the external is signified by the assembly. Such is the case with the external sense of the Word... and also with the externals of the Church and of worship...
From their faces they see whether their lower minds agree...
If they do not see a girl who is suitable to them...
The Angels are veiled over with a thin suitable cloud.
The like (arrangement according to the quarters) takes place in the assemblies (in Heaven). AE 422:7.
The nature of the assemblies in the Temples (in Heaven). Described.
They know no otherwise than that Heaven is in one place, where there is an assembly of all.
In the World of Spirits... is the first assembly of all (Spirits).
Still, in the World of Spirits all meet and speak together, when they long for it... But those who come into Heaven or into Hell see each other no more...
To proceed, is to be produced and presented in a suitable form...
I have seen such adoring a magician in an assembly...
The other receives and yields suitably.
There is another assembly (of the Babylonians) in the western quarter...
This place is called the Assembly of the Intelligent and Wise. AE 364:3.
Therefore no other light (than spiritual) is suitable to their essence.
It moves... also the face to agreement.
After this agreement the wise one said...
a. That after death two consorts for the most part meet... and live together for some time... General article.
This day the sign for the assembly has been given.

It often happens that after death friends meet... But when this consociation, which is solely of the external affections, is perceived in Heaven, a separation is effected according to the internal affections; and then from that assembly some are relegated into the north, and some into the west... so that they never see one another any more, nor do they Know one another...
The reason choice belongs to the men... is that the understanding can clearly see the agreements and disagreements...
In the first time of preparation (friends and relatives) meet... but they are separated by little and little, which is done insensibly.
These (haters) also meet... DMin 4775.
(The Quakers) in their meeting preach now and then... In their meetings they had constantly awaited the Holy Spirit.
An assembly of the perfidious ().
Occurs. AE 687:12.
By the Tent of the assembly was represented and thence signified Heaven, whence are the truths of the Church.
Nor one solitary in thine assemblies () = that not one truth will be left among the Knowledges.
The Mount of Assembly at the sides of the north () = where there is an ascent into the Heavens.
On Miracles. The Angels... said that they would sometimes invite me to their assemblies.
